sourceRule: All noncredential files, regardless of extension, including executable configuration, shell, fixtures, SQL source and source-read documentation. Nondot root files and .woodpecker.yaml are included; client dotfiles are demonstrably not execution inputs.
generatedEvidenceRule: Only direct build-* .json/.log files in generatedEvidenceDirectories are runner outputs; identically named fixtures elsewhere, reviewed configs, proposals, inventories and documentation remain inputs. Emit excludes its own dist, separately reconciled before publication. Other dist files remain inputs.
dependencyRule: Discover visible installed packages at every source importer node_modules; recursively follow actual Node ancestor resolution of dependencies, optionalDependencies and peerDependencies. Hash ALL files of each reached package (including package.json, runtime JS, TS declarations/lib chains, native/data assets), not every .pnpm package. Record all resolution probes and confined symlink identities. Development dependencies are already covered when installed at workspace importers; package-private development-only dependency trees are not execution inputs.
credentialRule: Never read .env*, .npmrc, .netrc, pgpass, userlist.txt, private-key/keypair/wallet/credential filenames or .pem/.key files. The separately approved env check hashes only the public .env.example via its existing assignment-name contract. The selected Node guard is not a native sandbox.
limits: A conservative installed package-resolution closure, not a proof against undeclared dynamic imports, native filesystem reads or concurrent noncooperating writers. Coordinator must freeze writers and review the actual imported closure before approval. Unsupported/escaping/dangling filesystem entries fail closed.
